question: Govt launches ‘GoIStats’ app for easy access to official data on the Go. Which organization developed the GoIStats app?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**NSO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Govt launches ‘GoIStats’ app for easy access to official data on the Go.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The government has launched the **‘GoIStats’ mobile application**.

 
 
• 
 
Developed by the **National Sample Survey Office (NSO)** under the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)**.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to make **official statistics** more **accessible and user-centric** for all stakeholders.

 
 
• 
 
The app includes a **“Key Trends” dashboard** with **interactive visualisations** of socio-economic indicators.

 
 
• 
 
It displays data on **GDP**, **inflation**, **employment**, and other metrics.
